overview: The committee reviewed detailed engineering reports on significant building deficiencies and compared existing school square footage against MSBA guidelines to begin forming the Preliminary Design Program.

items.title: New Member Introduction
items.summary: The committee welcomed Paul Malone, who was appointed by the School Committee to replace Tracy Keen.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Invoices
items.summary: Tabled the approval of the November 24, 2025 meeting minutes because they were not received by all members; approved the November 2025 invoice for OPM services totaling $25,000.

items.title: Project Budget Update
items.summary: Presented a budgetary correction for the MSBA to align contract values for environmental and site feasibility studies.

items.title: Existing Conditions Investigations
items.summary: Consultants detailed extensive deficiencies across the facility, including failing roof membranes, non-compliant accessibility routes, lack of seismic bracing, and mechanical systems that have exceeded their useful life. The report noted non-functional emergency generators and the absence of a comprehensive fire sprinkler system in most of the building.

items.title: Space Summary and Educational Program
items.summary: Architects compared existing school spaces to MSBA guidelines, highlighting that current gymnasium and dining areas exceed state standards while vocational and special education spaces must expand to meet modern requirements. The committee discussed the MSBA requirement to size the cafeteria for three lunch seatings and the potential inclusion of central administration and School Committee offices.

items.title: Site Analysis and Circulation
items.summary: Engineers reviewed the site's history as a former quarry and current challenges involving high impermeability, urban heat island effects, and a traffic bottleneck at the single Winthrop Street entrance.

items.title: Advisory Team Update and Project Schedule
items.summary: The committee reviewed the outcome of recent community listening sessions and set a target date of February 23rd for the approval of the Preliminary Design Program (PDP) submission to the MSBA.
